title: When Feasibility of Fairness Audits Relies on Willingness to Share Data: Examining User Acceptance of Multi-Party Computation Protocols for Fairness Monitoring
reasoning: The paper focuses on user acceptance of privacy protocols (MPC) for fairness monitoring in automated hiring. While it discusses 'fairness,' it does so through the lens of algorithmic accountability and user privacy calculus rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
